bug_semantics: With OAuth enabled behind a reverse proxy that terminates browser-facing HTTPS and forwards the callback to Temporal UI Server over HTTP, authentication cookies used c.Request().TLS != nil to choose Secure. That request describes only the proxy-to-server hop, so the server could emit user* access/ID-token cookies and, later, refresh-token cookies without Secure even though the browser authenticated over HTTPS. Exploitation additionally requires steering the UI hostname to attacker-served HTTP, preventing HTTPS, and receiving a later same-site plaintext request while the credential is live; malicious content alone or passive observation of the successful TLS session is insufficient.
flaw_origin: temporalio/ui-server PR #219 moved the OAuth session from server-side cookies that forced Secure=true into browser-resident user* cookies containing the access token and set Secure from c.Request().TLS. The PR's sole source commit 8bca548c78fcadc737626bea96ef1e16075792d6 is the smallest real BIC. GitHub squash commit 821cf598371353f1b579dfe1e87aeb3638b041d6 landed the identical parent/tree/patch, temporalio/ui commit c6f84170173eb9e9d82a98fd78faf4adc8af09ed later imported the existing server tree, and later refresh-token work reused the same faulty transport inference; the squash, import, and extensions are not the origin.
ai_marker: absent — `git cat-file commit 8bca548c78fcadc737626bea96ef1e16075792d6` shows author and committer feedmeapples <aksenov.ro@outlook.com> and only the one-line message `Store user session in browser`; there is no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, AI-tool, bot, or automation marker in the BIC commit object.
evidence: Advisory check: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c7mm-29xf-mmqp describes the reverse-proxy TLS mismatch and the additional hostname/HTTP prerequisites, marks affected and patched versions as Unknown, and cites temporalio/ui#3806, ui-server commits 821cf598371353f1b579dfe1e87aeb3638b041d6 and 8876b80b63003688ab736f45ef28885695a4f6db, and releases v2.53.1 and v2.53.2.

Disputed introducer check: the primary selected landed squash 821cf598371353f1b579dfe1e87aeb3638b041d6, while the reviewer selected source member 8bca548c78fcadc737626bea96ef1e16075792d6. Fetching public `refs/pull/219/head` read-only into a temporary bare repository and running `git rev-list --reverse fca4a6967d9e4fb1c8b1521e185bd70d99ba26d8..refs/remotes/origin/pr-219` returns exactly 8bca548c78fcadc737626bea96ef1e16075792d6. Its raw commit object has tree 12b0727fd89f1703a5bf20a052cb7a28bb888608 and parent fca4a6967d9e4fb1c8b1521e185bd70d99ba26d8; `git cat-file commit 821cf598371353f1b579dfe1e87aeb3638b041d6` in the validated clone shows the landed squash has that same tree and parent. Stable patch-id for each object is 777cd692b449860d5887c5ebce565c00b99d8396. Therefore the reviewer wins: the one-member PR head is the smallest reconstructable BIC, and the primary stopped one aggregate object too late.

Direct parent check: `git diff fca4a6967d9e4fb1c8b1521e185bd70d99ba26d8 8bca548c78fcadc737626bea96ef1e16075792d6 -- server/auth/auth.go` replaces the prior server-side session implementation whose cookie options force `Secure: true` with a new user* cookie containing the OAuth access/ID token and `Secure: c.Request().TLS != nil`. The vulnerable mechanism is absent from the immediate parent and is written by the BIC.

Aggregate/move rejection: `git show --stat c6f84170173eb9e9d82a98fd78faf4adc8af09ed` in temporalio/ui is `Import ui-server. (#1112)` and adds 87 files and 7,211 lines, including server/server/auth/auth.go wholesale. It imports an already-vulnerable implementation and is not a BIC. The landed GitHub squash is likewise rejected in favor of its exact public PR member.

Version boundary check: after fetching only boundary tags, `git tag --contains 821cf598371353f1b579dfe1e87aeb3638b041d6 --sort=version:refname` starts with v2.7.0 among v2.6.2/v2.7.0/v2.53.1/v2.53.2. `git diff --unified=1 v2.6.2 v2.7.0 -- server/auth/auth.go` shows the transition from unconditional `Secure: true` server-side session cookies to the token-bearing user* cookie with request-TLS-derived Secure, establishing v2.6.2 as the checked safe boundary and v2.7.0 as the first checked vulnerable release.

Fix and patched boundary: `git diff 1ed83780edfe2e395048d354976f6487b206b9db^ 1ed83780edfe2e395048d354976f6487b206b9db -- server/server/auth/auth.go server/server/route/auth.go` replaces all auth-cookie Request().TLS checks with a `secure` value derived from the browser-facing OIDC callback URL scheme. Released ui-server sync 8876b80b63003688ab736f45ef28885695a4f6db carries that change; `git tag --contains 8876b80b63003688ab736f45ef28885695a4f6db --sort=version:refname` returns v2.53.2 among the fetched boundary tags, and `git diff --unified=1 v2.53.1 v2.53.2 -- server/auth/auth.go server/route/auth.go` shows the vulnerable derivations replaced in v2.53.2.

BIC-only AI check: the raw 8bca548c78fcadc737626bea96ef1e16075792d6 commit object contains a human author/committer identity and a one-line subject with no AI or automation signal. The GitHub committer and PR-number subject on squash 821cf598371353f1b579dfe1e87aeb3638b041d6, as well as later/fix evidence, are excluded from attribution.
reasoning: The vulnerability begins when PR #219 changes the security boundary: sensitive OAuth credentials move into browser cookies and their Secure attribute begins reflecting the backend request's TLS state rather than the browser-facing scheme. The direct parent has only server-side session cookies fixed to Secure=true. On the sole disputed field, the reviewer is correct and the primary is not: 8bca548c78fcadc737626bea96ef1e16075792d6 is the only commit on the public PR head and has the same parent, tree, and stable patch-id as landed squash 821cf598371353f1b579dfe1e87aeb3638b041d6, so protocol requires the smaller real source member rather than the squash aggregate. The later monorepo import and refresh-token additions preserve or widen the mechanism but do not originate it. The direct fix derives Secure from the configured browser callback URL and its ui-server sync is present in v2.53.2. Because the verified BIC commit object has no AI marker, the gate-complete verdict is NOT_AI.
